bull.b: FDA feedback that CNM-Au8 data may support accelerated approval and potential surrogate endpoint (neurofilament light) creates a durable regulatory pathway. Acceptance can shorten time-to-market, de-risk development sequencing and, if confirmed, materially improve commercial and partnership prospects long-term.

bull.t: Liability management and fresh equity funding
bull.b: Extending note maturities and deferring principal lowers immediate cash obligations, while a $7M registered offering boosts cash. Together these moves materially ease near-term liquidity pressure, extending runway into late-2026/2027 and allowing management to focus on NDA filing and Phase 3 planning without imminent refinancing.

Board continuity, auditor ratification and an enlarged equity pool support governance stability and retention via stock incentives. For a clinical-stage biotech, durable talent retention and clear governance reduce execution risk for regulatory filings and late-stage trials over the next 2–3 years.

bear.t: Minimal revenue and persistent large losses
bear.b: Revenue is effectively immaterial while operating losses are large and persistent. This structural mismatch means the company cannot self-fund development; until regulatory approval or material partnerships occur, operating results will remain loss-making and reliant on external capital, raising dilution risk.

Negative equity alongside meaningful debt reduces financial flexibility and increases creditor priority. In adverse scenarios this position limits strategic options, raises refinancing and covenant risks, and can materially increase financing costs, constraining long-term investment in trials and commercialization.

bear.t: Heavy cash burn and dependence on financing
bear.b: Sustained ~-$18M annual operating cash burn necessitates repeated capital raises or debt relief to fund development and trials. This structural cash dependency increases execution risk, potential program delays if markets tighten, and ongoing shareholder dilution until a revenue-generating product or sizable partner appears.
